decision.rationale: TXN-008106 is a 173.32 EUR purchase at Ashgrove Apparel on card CRD-000067. It posted on 2026-08-14, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 72 days later. That is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000068) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-08-17. The dispute was opened 69 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period has passed. The carrier's delivery record (DOC-000069) shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-08-17 to the cardholder's address in Tampere and signed for by O. Quinn. The cardholder, CH-000056, is Olga Quinn of Tampere, so the address and the signature both match her. Under the proof-of-delivery rule, the goods count as received and the dispute is declined. Neither the statement nor the documents contained any instruction to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your order was delivered to your address in Tampere on 2026-08-17 and signed for in your name (O. Quinn), so the goods are treated as received.
